It omits first-chunk/finalization widening and leaves core/ring/API files unchanged. Desired independent-pass test6502f1f3 first rejects the singleton remedy. Existing output8/16 assembly is byte-identical to cd2880f1; exact-source proofs/eight rejecting controls/cache tests/native instruction cross-check just passed onEPYC. Native x86 quality/mutation is running onIce. This is a personal draft, not an owner-selected safety composition or a nativeARM recovery claim.

Please confirm the optimization base when convenient; the test-only safety children remain directly reviewable on their requested parents. I will keep your native quiet work isolated.
